newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes soft in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes soft in slow trade.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso closed soft on Thursday following dollar short-covering by some local dealers in cautious trade, traders said.

"Some who oversold (dollars) yesterday stepped in to cover (short dollar) positions this morning. Those who have dollars don't want to do anything ahead of Friday's figures," said a trader, referring to U.S. September employment figures.
The same-day peso closed 0.3 of a centavo softer at 7.5135/7.5160 per dollar in thin volume.
The 48-hour and 24-hour peso were meanwhile 1.2 and 0.5 of a centavo weaker, respectively, at 7.5280/7.5330 and 7.5170/7.5220 per dollar.
